The '''Mon Calamari Knights''' were some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] greatest warriors. Originally introduced in [[Dac/Legends|Dac's]] ancient times, these soldiers were later regarded as fulfilling little more than a traditional role. However, the [[Mon Calamari Council]] used these elite fighters to successfully fight off the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces of the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]] during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

[[File:MonCalKnight_cw5.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Mon Calamari Knight [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|in action]].]]

A Mon Calamari Knight wore armor crafted from the plates of a [[titan kantrey]], mixed with modern materials mined by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]. Each Knight was further protected by a [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]-woven [[Cowill|cowell]]-shell shield, armed with a single [[Energy lance/Legends|energy lance]],<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and often mounted on a furious and swift [[Keelkana/Legends|keelkana]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
